fullPassage: If you are a career-focused mum, non-career-focused mums may judge you for making money a higher priority than your kids. If you are an artist who creates a craze in music, film, or art, and you cash in, others who haven't made money from their art may call you a 'sell-out'. If you are a business owner who makes hard decisions, has to fire people and negotiate big contracts, people may call you cold or greedy. People will call you what they see, not what you are. You know who you are. You know what you've been through. You know the sacrifices you've made. Embrace the critics just like you embrace the fans. You can't have one without the other. Let them judge you how they will and do not allow either the criticism or the praise to go to your head. Just be you and do what you do.
